mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns: lower FEDFUNDS levels predict positive returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.5%, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is above 255, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by HOUST above 1000 and GDPC1 growth rate above 2% year-over-year), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4%, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns: higher INDPRO levels predict positive returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 260, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and the employment level (PAYEMS) growth rate is below 0.5% year-over-year, S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite the signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
